method: Each original desktop-closed.png, desktop-open.png, mobile-closed.png and mobile-open.png under smoke/ID/ and each marketing/ID.webp was separately submitted to vision_analyze. No comparison boards were used. Parent findings were consulted only after independent image inspection.
scope: Static visual review of supplied original files, not fresh browser execution, calibrated material comparison, hash provenance verification, collision testing or user approval.
common_findings: All supplied desktop/mobile open/closed views contain the complete model and controls without obvious viewport clipping, horizontal overflow or overlapping text.
Mobile secondary labels and disclaimers are small; fine textures and edges soften or alias at phone scale.
Closed lid seams are conspicuous, but also occur in the marketing references; they do not independently establish a closure defect.

Open-state rear hinge clearances and projecting released latch tabs can look tenuously attached. Static images do not establish detached meshes, pivot errors or motion collisions; retain as mechanical-readability concerns rather than confirmed critical failures.
No definite critical visible fault was identified. None of these findings clears inherited approval, source acceptance, storage or release holds.

entries.qualification: Conservative finish hold is justified, but the parent wording about low apparent ornament relief is too broad: the white lid ornaments visibly project above the top in the original desktop capture.
entries.desktop_closed: Timber courses, finger joints, white side diamonds, raised lid geometry, brass clasp/ring/caps and gray feet are readable. Top panel is noticeably lighter and flatter than the sides; grain is regular and striped. Entire silhouette fits.
entries.desktop_open: Empty timber cavity and raised lid are visible and uncropped. Rear attachment reads somewhat separated; no definite missing panel or severe intersection.
entries.mobile_closed: Country motif and hardware remain legible; complete chest and UI fit. Fine timber detail is less resolved.
entries.mobile_open: Interior and lid remain fully visible, with no blocking layout fault. Small supporting text persists.
entries.marketing_comparison: Same timber chest, hollow white lid squares, side diamonds, joinery and principal hardware. Marketing wood is more muted and evenly integrated; runtime top/body tonal split and uniform grain are stronger. No obvious identity substitution.

entries.qualification: Visible palette/finish difference supports the hold; do not infer actual glaze composition from either image.
entries.desktop_closed: Cobalt/ivory floral panels, central raised flower, tiled border, gold hardware and square feet are intact. Runtime frame is smooth orange/terracotta. Dark lid seam is prominent but not a demonstrated defect.
entries.desktop_open: Ivory cavity and plain terracotta inner lid are exposed, all within frame. Rear hinge gaps and projecting tab warrant readability caution, not a confirmed failure.
entries.mobile_closed: Large flower remains recognizable; small side petals merge into patterned texture with aliasing. Model, buttons and title are contained.
entries.mobile_open: Complete open silhouette and pale cavity remain visible; no clipped controls or major visible penetration.
entries.marketing_comparison: Same floral medallion, small blue flowers, border, clasp and feet. Marketing frame is visibly coral/salmon and granular; runtime is more orange and smooth. This is more directly observable than a claim of nuanced glaze fidelity.

entries.qualification: Repeated soft/checkered surface pattern, especially across the open lid/interior, is a clear quality concern. Mountain theme remains recognizable.
entries.desktop_closed: Green foothills, gray volcanic slopes and white summit sit on the ochre chest. Summit is simplified and chest texture looks soft/repetitive. No cropping or catastrophic geometry fault.
entries.desktop_open: Raised lid and hollow interior fit. Broad repeated texture is conspicuous across inner surfaces; rear hinges visually span an obvious gap.
entries.mobile_closed: Snowcap and mountain silhouette remain readable; chest and controls fully contained. Fine material detail is weak.
entries.mobile_open: Checkered/mottled interior and loose-looking rear attachment remain visible. No definite critical intersection or layout failure.
entries.marketing_comparison: Both retain honey/ochre body, brass fittings, green mountain base and white recessed summit. Marketing has softer integrated wood variation and a clearer summit/crater impression; runtime remains a simplified painted miniature rather than rugged volcanic terrain. Reference itself is stylized.

entries.qualification: Hold is reasonable for finish acceptance, not evidence of lost composition. Both images are visibly graphic/stylized; richer promotional glaze is not firmly established from these views.
entries.desktop_closed: Ivory floral-rosette panels, cobalt frame, raised scarlet tulips and turquoise foliage remain clear. Pattern ends abruptly at panel boundaries. No major missing geometry or cropping.
entries.desktop_open: Cobalt inner lid and pale empty cavity are intact. Hinge gap is visually conspicuous; no confirmed disconnection or penetration.
entries.mobile_closed: Tulip colors and broad floral identity survive at phone scale; rosette detail softens. No overflow or cropped model.
entries.mobile_open: Entire blue lid, cavity, clasp and feet are in frame. Broad patterned/checkered shading on the inner lid is noticeable.
entries.marketing_comparison: Same blue/ivory chest, three coral/mint tulips, repeating rosettes, corner caps and ring hardware. Runtime tulips are more saturated scarlet, foliage more turquoise and body pattern softer. Identity and ornament placement are substantially retained.

entries.qualification: Material-pattern and shallow-gorge readability support a cautious hold. Different camera framing prevents a measured claim that the terrain is physically shallower.
entries.desktop_closed: Pale green-gray body, rolling hills, pale-blue winding channel and round vegetation are readable. Body mottling repeats; dark pointed terrain-edge seam at rear/right is ambiguous rather than proven clipping.
entries.desktop_open: Hollow cavity and raised lid fit entirely. Broad regular texture is obvious; rear hinge/lid junction can read disconnected, with no definite major fault.
entries.mobile_closed: Winding channel survives but reads more like a river between smooth banks than a deep gorge. Full box and UI remain visible.
entries.mobile_open: Interior is readable and complete; angular rim junctions and soft checked texture persist. No viewport clipping.
entries.marketing_comparison: Same pale stone-like chest, brass fittings, green hills and winding river with pale banks. Both are stylized. Marketing terrain edges and relief read more pronounced; runtime shell texture is more visibly regular and blurred. No confirmed missing river or landmark.

entries.qualification: Keep the artistic hold, but qualify the parent claim of irregular promotional rocks: the inspected reference also has a compact smooth tiered stack. The stronger observable concern is masonry/material regularity and generic stacked-pebble readability.
entries.desktop_closed: Staggered pale masonry, thick slab lid, tan oval patch, stacked rounded stones, pebble feet and brass fittings are clear. Dark lid seam persists. No large mesh failure or cropped silhouette.
entries.desktop_open: Empty stone-lined cavity and thick inner lid are visible; broad angular mottling and uncertain rear attachment are noncritical visual concerns.
entries.mobile_closed: Masonry and stacked-stone silhouette remain readable. All controls and model fit; small labels remain small.
entries.mobile_open: Entire raised lid and feet remain contained. Dark cavity loses some contrast and small stone edges alias, without a demonstrated structural failure.
entries.marketing_comparison: Same pale brick-pattern chest, stacked smooth stones on oval base, pebble feet and gold hardware. Marketing reads smoother/marble-like and runtime masonry more repetitive. Both can read as a generic balanced-pebble ornament rather than distinctly weathered kopjes; reference does not establish cultural/geographic accuracy.
